<h1 class="mkt-title">Marketing Campaign Development</h1>

<div class="mkt-box mkt-box1">
<p>During the winter of 2025, I travelled with a small group of UC Davis students
and a small group of Nepali students to a remote village in Nepal. The goal was
to support a small, marginalized women-led agricultural cooperative in the
village to produce and market peanuts.</p>
</div>

<div class="mkt-box mkt-box2">
<p>I was part of a subgroup focused on marketing. We performed in-depth market
and target demographic analyses of both the local village and larger Nepali
cities. We also created cost analyses of various value-added products (roasted
peanuts, peanut butter, etc.) We included all of this information in a small
booklet for the cooperative to use throughout the next couple of years. We also
provided them with logos and sample social media videos for immediate marketing
use.</p>

<p>We also created a longer-term marketing plan, which included a larger social
media campaign targeted at domestic tourists interested in agro-tourism. From a
PR perspective, the goal was to highlight local stories of the farmers and the
traditional agricultural practices of their marginalized community. Interested
tourists would be able to actually participate in a &ldquo;homestay&rdquo;
experience, living in the field with farmers. While peanuts would not be
directly sold in this process, we concluded that this approach would be more
profitable long-term.</p>
</div>
